subject: english
topic: Antonyms: word opposite in meaning to the underlined word (mark the target word in CAPITALS in the sentence)

kept.q: Choose the option OPPOSITE in meaning to the word in capitals: During the rainy season, food crops are usually ABUNDANT in the markets of eastern Nigeria.
kept.explanation: ABUNDANT means existing in large quantity. The opposite is 'scarce', which means not enough or in short supply.
kept.pidgin: ABUNDANT mean say e plenty well well. The opposite be 'scarce', wey mean say e no plenty or e dey hard to see.

kept.q: Choose the option OPPOSITE in meaning to the word in capitals: The auditor was METICULOUS in checking every entry in the company's account books.
kept.explanation: METICULOUS means very careful and paying close attention to detail. 'Careless' means lacking attention or not being careful, which is the opposite.
kept.pidgin: METICULOUS mean say person dey very careful well well for small small detail. 'Careless' mean say person no dey careful at all, so na the opposite.

kept.q: Choose the option OPPOSITE in meaning to the word in capitals: The weather at the beach in Lagos was TRANQUIL throughout our visit.
kept.explanation: TRANQUIL means calm and peaceful, without disturbance. 'Turbulent' means stormy or full of disorder, which is the direct opposite.
kept.pidgin: TRANQUIL mean say e calm and peaceful, no wahala. 'Turbulent' mean say e rough and get plenty confusion, na so e be opposite.

kept.q: Choose the option OPPOSITE in meaning to the word in capitals: Despite several warnings, the OBSTINATE driver refused to obey the traffic rules.
kept.explanation: OBSTINATE describes someone who refuses to change their mind or behaviour even when advised. 'Compliant' means willing to obey or follow rules, which is the opposite behaviour.
kept.pidgin: OBSTINATE mean say person no wan change im mind even if dem advise am. 'Compliant' mean say person dey ready to follow rule, na so e be di opposite.

kept.q: Choose the option OPPOSITE in meaning to the word in capitals: Mrs. Adeyemi's FRUGAL lifestyle helped her save enough money to build a house in Ibadan.
kept.explanation: FRUGAL means careful with money and avoiding waste. 'Extravagant' means spending money carelessly or more than necessary, which is the opposite.
kept.pidgin: FRUGAL mean say person dey use money well, no waste am. 'Extravagant' mean say person dey waste money anyhow, na so e be di opposite.

kept.q: Choose the option OPPOSITE in meaning to the word in capitals: The museum in Benin City displayed many ANCIENT artifacts from the old kingdom.
kept.explanation: ANCIENT means belonging to a very distant past time. 'Modern' means belonging to the present time, which is the opposite meaning.
kept.pidgin: ANCIENT mean say e dey from old old time wey don pass. 'Modern' mean say e dey from present time now, na so e be di opposite.
